description.zh:
是否解绑实例的全部标签，取值：

- **true**：是。解绑实例的全部标签。
- **false**：否。需在**TagKey.N**参数传入需解绑的实例标签。

> - **TagKey.N**和本参数至少传入一个。
- 如果同时传入了**TagKey.N**和本参数，则本参数不生效。
description.en:
Specifies whether to unbind instance tags from the instance. Valid values:

- **true**: Unbinds instance tags from the instance.
- **false**: Does not unbind instance tags. You must specify the tags to unbind in the **TagKey.N** parameter.

> - You must specify at least one of **TagKey.N** and this parameter.
- If you specify both **TagKey.N** and this parameter, this parameter does not take effect.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
数据迁移、同步和订阅实例的ID，可以通过调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)接口查询。
> N表示传入第几个实例ID。例如ResourceId.0表示传入第一个实例ID；ResourceId.1表示传入第二个实例ID。可以同时对1~50个实例解绑标签。
description.en:
The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query instance IDs.
> N specifies the sequence number of the instance ID. For example, ResourceId.0 specifies the first instance ID, and ResourceId.1 specifies the second instance ID. You can unbind tags from 1 to 50 instances at a time.

description.zh: 资源类型定义。唯一取值：**ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE**。
description.en: The resource type. The only valid value is **ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE**.

description.zh:
标签键。
> - N表示传入第几个标签的键。例如TagKey.0表示传入第一个标签的键；TagKey.1表示传入第二个标签的键。可以同时解绑1~20个标签键。
- 不允许传入空字符串。
- **All**和本参数至少传入一个。
- 如果同时传入了**All**和本参数，则只有本参数生效。
description.en:
The tag key.
> - N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, TagKey.0 specifies the first tag key, and TagKey.1 specifies the second tag key. You can unbind 1 to 20 tag keys at a time.
- Empty strings are not allowed.
- You must specify at least one of **All** and this parameter.
- If you specify both **All** and this parameter, only this parameter takes effect.

descriptions.zh: > 标签从一个实例解绑后，如果没有绑定到其它实例，则该标签自动被删除。
descriptions.en: > After a tag is unbound from an instance, the tag is automatically deleted if it is not bound to any other instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE --all false --resource-id dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --tag-key testkey1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --TagKey.1 testkey1 --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
